images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: premium travel website hero, landscape 16:9. Create a geographically plausible editorial illustration of Punta Espinosa on Fernandina Island, Galapagos, Ecuador. Several anatomically accurate dark marine iguanas resting on low black pahoehoe basalt lava beside calm blue Pacific water, a few red Sally Lightfoot crabs small in scene, low sparse mangroves and broad low shield volcanic slopes behind. Wider natural coastal scene with iguana group on right, soft open ocean and sky on left for website title. No tropical palms, no jungle, no snow, no red flowing lava or dramatic eruption, no buildings. Crisp realistic rock textures, true animal proportions, clear warm daylight. No letters logos watermark or collage.
images.alt: Морские игуаны у воды на Пунта-Эспинозе — иллюстрация
